title: v1 admitted roughly half of what its own accepted sources contain today
finding: For every source v1 actually drew training candidates from, the dataset-viewer total read on 2026-09-20 is about twice what v1 took.
arithmetic: v1 took 38,119 candidates in total. Those four sources alone report 89,633 rows in the viewer today. The remaining v1 sources (Roblox/creator-docs 16,781 and luau-lang/site 431) are retrieval references, not training rows, and are excluded from this comparison.
provenance: v1_took figures are quoted from the v1 status report supplied in the task brief; viewer_total figures are from the huggingface dataset-viewer /size endpoint read on 2026-09-20.
caveat: I do NOT know why the gap exists and I am not claiming v1 was wrong. It could be deliberate dedup, a quality filter, or taking only one split. The point is only that the gap is large and its cause is unrecorded. Whoever runs the build should establish the cause before treating the difference as available headroom.
why_it_matters: The cheapest path to a materially larger corpus may be re-deriving from sources v1 ALREADY cleared on rights, not acquiring new ones. That work carries no new licence risk.
